scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
Finally I've found you, Vagabond Spike! Your neck is mine!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
總算找到你了，浪人斯派克！
你的腦袋，我要定了！

scripts.text: Say what?
scripts.translation: 你說什麼？

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
*Snort* Don't pretend like you don't know. Look at this poster! You're in it!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
哼，別裝蒜！看看這張通緝令，畫的就是你！

scripts.text: I see the resemblance, but that's not me.
scripts.translation: 我看確實有幾分相似，但那不是我。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Forget the resemblance. Where did you get that poster? I've never committed a crime.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
先別管像不像，這通緝令哪兒來的？
我可沒犯過罪。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
I knew you'd try to lie your way out.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
我就知道你會試圖撒謊脫身。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
The ^0000ffEinbroch Private Pub^000000 has released that wanted poster. You have many bounty hunters like me on your heels.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
^0000ff艾音布羅克私人酒館^000000釋出了那張通緝令。像我這樣的賞金獵人正追在你身後。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
I don't care if you're the right one so long as you look it and I can take you dead or alive.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
我不在乎你到底是不是通緝犯，只要你看起來像他，我就能把你死活不論地帶去交差。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
It's you again! You've got guts to come back here!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
又是你！你居然敢回來！

scripts.text: Make a run for it.
scripts.translation: 逃跑

scripts.text: Fight him.
scripts.translation: 戰鬥

scripts.text: ^0000ffI should run for now and think about this later.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff先跑再說，之後再想辦法。^000000

scripts.text: ^0000ffHe's not the only bounty hunter after me, if he's telling the truth. I need time to strategize.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff如果他說的是真的，盯上我的賞金獵人可不止一個，得從長計議。^000000

scripts.text:
[Bouncer]
No loitering around the venue.
scripts.translation:
[看場人]
禁止在店外逗留。

scripts.text:
[Bouncer]
Under construction, can't get in.
scripts.translation:
[看場人]
正在施工，無法進入。

scripts.text:
[Bouncer]
*Gasp* You! I thought you were already captured. Ooh, doesn't matter now. You're my Get Out of Jail Free card!
scripts.translation:
[看場人]
啊！是你！我還以為你已經被抓了。哎，現在不重要了。你就是我的免罪金牌！

scripts.text: I'm not the criminal you think I am!
scripts.translation: 我不是你以為的那個罪犯！

scripts.text:
[Bouncer]
You aren't?
scripts.translation:
[看場人]
你不是？

scripts.text: ^0000ffThe bouncer examines your face.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff看場人打量著你的臉。^000000

scripts.text:
[Bouncer]
Hm, you bear a striking resemblance, though you don't look not as menacing as that criminal Spike
scripts.translation:
[看場人]
嗯，你長得確實很像，不過你看起來不像那個罪犯斯派克那麼兇惡。

scripts.text: I want to talk to the poster publisher.
scripts.translation: 我要見釋出通緝令的人

scripts.text:
[Bouncer]
Your problem is a bit out of my league. Get in. If I find out you're the real deal all along, I'll see that you'll never see the outside again.
scripts.translation:
[看場人]
這事我管不了，進去吧。
但要是讓我發現你真是那個罪犯，就別想再出去了。

scripts.text:
[Bouncer]
You're back. Why?
scripts.translation:
[看場人]
你又回來了。為什麼？

scripts.text: I want in.
scripts.translation: 我要進去

scripts.text: I was passing by.
scripts.translation: 我只是路過

scripts.text:
[Bouncer]
You're silly.
scripts.translation:
[看場人]
你真傻。

scripts.text:
[Bouncer]
Go ahead. Stay out of trouble.
scripts.translation:
[看場人]
去吧。別惹麻煩。

scripts.text:
[Ruthless Rebellion]
Do you know how to use a gun?
scripts.translation:
[冷酷的反叛者]
你會用槍嗎？

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Gunslinger]
...
scripts.translation:
[可疑的神槍手]
...

scripts.text:
[Quiet Gunslinger]
Don't say I look like a blacksmith you know.
scripts.translation:
[沉默的神槍手]
別說我長得像你認識的某個鐵匠。

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
*Hiccups* Oh, I'm the owner here.
Oh wait, am I in the pub or someplace else? Zzz...
scripts.translation:
[醉漢]
嗝...哦，我是這兒的老闆。
等等，這兒是酒館還是哪兒來著？呼嚕...

scripts.text:
[Anxious Man]
Maybe I'm in the wrong place. This place doesn't look like a pub.
scripts.translation:
[焦慮的男子]
也許我走錯地方了。這裡看起來不像酒吧。

scripts.text:
[Kulbertinov]
Do you want to see the boss?
scripts.translation:
[庫爾貝爾蒂諾夫]
你想見老闆嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text:
[Kulbertinov]
Are you looking for me?
scripts.translation:
[庫爾貝爾蒂諾夫]
你在找我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kulbertinov]
Can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[庫爾貝爾蒂諾夫]
有什麼可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kulbertinov]
What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[庫爾貝爾蒂諾夫]
你想要什麼？

scripts.text: I'm mistaken for a criminal!.
scripts.translation: 我被誤認為是罪犯了！

scripts.text:
[Kulbertinov]
Wait a minute... Mwah hah hah!
scripts.translation:
[庫爾貝爾蒂諾夫]
等一下...哇哈哈！

scripts.text: ^0000ffHe scans your face, then guffaws.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff他看了看你的臉，然後大笑起來。^000000

scripts.text:
[Kulbertinov]
I'm sorry. For a moment, I thought Spike came back to life. He was found dead three days ago.
scripts.translation:
[庫爾貝爾蒂諾夫]
抱歉。剛才一瞬間，我以為斯派克復活了。他三天前被發現死了。

scripts.text: He was captured already?
scripts.translation: 他已經被抓住了？

scripts.text:
[Kulbertinov]
Yes, and the bounty hunter was already paid. The news hasn't spread, and you're the spitting image of him. Go figure.
scripts.translation:
[庫爾貝爾蒂諾夫]
抓到了，賞金也發了。
不過訊息還沒傳開，你又和他長得一模一樣，難怪會這樣。

scripts.text: You have to do something!
scripts.translation: 你得做點什麼！

scripts.text:
[Kulbertinov]
I'm sorry, but I can't talk to every single bounty hunter for you. Of course, I'm willing to compensate for your inconvenience.
scripts.translation:
[庫爾貝爾蒂諾夫]
抱歉，總不能讓我挨個去跟賞金獵人解釋吧。
不過，給你添了麻煩，我願意補償。

scripts.text:
[Kulbertinov]
Hey, how about you join our ranks? At the very last, you won't get shot.
scripts.translation:
[庫爾貝爾蒂諾夫]
嘿，要不要加入我們？至少這樣，你就不會挨槍子。

scripts.text: You want me become a bounty hunter?
scripts.translation: 你想讓我成為賞金獵人？

scripts.text:
[Kulbertinov]
No, bounty hunting is just a pastime. We're the experts of all the firearms in the world.
scripts.translation:
[庫爾貝爾蒂諾夫]
不，捉拿通緝犯只是消遣。
我們精通世上各式槍械。

scripts.text:
[Kulbertinov]
Carefree spirits!
Magical spitfires!
We call ourselves the ^0000ffRebellion^000000.
scripts.translation:
[庫爾貝爾蒂諾夫]
自由不羈的靈魂！
魔法般的槍火！
我們自稱^0000ff反叛者^000000。

scripts.text:
[Kulbertinov]
You look like you know how to use a gun. How'd you like to join our ranks? You won't have to worry about other bounty hunters anymore too.
scripts.translation:
[庫爾貝爾蒂諾夫]
你看起來像是知道怎麼用槍。要不要加入我們？這樣你也不用再擔心其他賞金獵人了。

scripts.text: Let me think it over.
scripts.translation: 讓我考慮一下

scripts.text: I don't think I have a choice.
scripts.translation: 我覺得我沒得選

scripts.text:
[Kulbertinov]
You can think it over and over, but the answer won't change. Just take the offer.
scripts.translation:
[庫爾貝爾蒂諾夫]
你可以考慮再考慮，但答案不會變。就接受這個提議吧。

scripts.text:
[Kulbertinov]
Good thinking. Might as well do it now and get it over with.
scripts.translation:
[庫爾貝爾蒂諾夫]
明智，不如現在就辦，早點了結。

scripts.text:
[Kulbertinov]
Talk to Enwin Conick. She guides drifting spirits like you to the way of the Rebellion. I'll send word to her. Ah, and don't point your gun at her.
scripts.translation:
[庫爾貝爾蒂諾夫]
去找埃爾溫·科尼克吧，她會指引你這樣的漂泊者走上反叛者的道路。
我會打個招呼。
對了，別把槍口對著她。

scripts.text:
[Kulbertinov]
Do you have business with Elwin Conick?
scripts.translation:
[庫爾貝爾蒂諾夫]
你要找埃爾溫·科尼克嗎？

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text: Send me to Elwin Conick.
scripts.translation: 帶我去找埃爾溫·科尼克

scripts.text:
[Kulbertinov]
All right. Care for a shot of vodka?
scripts.translation:
[庫爾貝爾蒂諾夫]
好的。想喝點伏特加嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kulbertinov]
Okay, I'll let her know.
scripts.translation:
[庫爾貝爾蒂諾夫]
好，我會通知她的。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
If you don't want to join Rebellions, just get out.
scripts.translation:
[埃爾溫·科尼克]
如果你不想加入反叛者組織，就滾出去。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
Do you to join us Rebellions?
scripts.translation:
[埃爾溫·科尼克]
你要加入我們反叛者組織嗎？

scripts.text: ^0000ffThe short woman with keen eyes stares into your eyes.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff那位目光銳利的矮個子女子凝視著你的眼睛。^000000

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
Sign here.
scripts.translation:
[埃爾溫·科尼克]
在這裡簽字。

scripts.text: ^0000ffThe undersigned party '_____' will not speak of the test even if he or she suffers injury, mutilation, or death in an unforeseen accident that may occur during the test.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff簽署人“_____”承諾，即使在測試期間遭遇不可預見的事故，導致受傷、致殘或死亡，也不會洩露測試內容。^000000

scripts.text: WHAT?!
scripts.translation: 什麼？！

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
Do you want join us or not?
scripts.translation:
[埃爾溫·科尼克]
你到底要不要加入我們？

scripts.text: I give up.
scripts.translation: 我放棄了

scripts.text: ...I'll sign.

[Elwin Conick]
Your choice.
scripts.translation:
[埃爾溫·科尼克]
這是你的選擇。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
Good. Now, follow me.
scripts.translation:
[埃爾溫·科尼克]
很好。現在，跟我來。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
Do you want to try again?
scripts.translation:
[埃爾溫·科尼克]
你想再試一次嗎？

scripts.text: I give up.
scripts.translation: 我放棄了

scripts.text: Do it.
scripts.translation: 開始吧

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
Your choice.
scripts.translation:
[埃爾溫·科尼克]
這是你的選擇。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
Follow me.
scripts.translation:
[埃爾溫·科尼克]
跟我來。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
You still have Ivan's shooting test, do you want to try again?
scripts.translation:
[埃爾溫·科尼克]
你還有伊萬的射擊測試沒完成，想再試一次嗎？

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
Ivan's shooting test have not finished yet, do you want to try again?
scripts.translation:
[埃爾溫·科尼克]
伊萬的射擊測試還沒結束，你想再試一次嗎？

scripts.text: I give up.
scripts.translation: 我放棄了

scripts.text: Do it.
scripts.translation: 開始吧

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
It's not worth to give up, now go out and relax.
scripts.translation:
[埃爾溫·科尼克]
現在放棄不值得，出去放鬆一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
Remember to give your best.
scripts.translation:
[埃爾溫·科尼克]
記住，要全力以赴。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
Ivan is waiting for you, go find him.
scripts.translation:
[埃爾溫·科尼克]
伊萬在等你，去找他吧。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
You have no more test to take. Why don't you go out and have a drink?
scripts.translation:
[埃爾溫·科尼克]
你已經沒有測試要參加了。不如出去喝一杯？

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
If you don't want to join Rebellions, just get out.
scripts.translation:
[埃爾溫·科尼克]
如果你不想加入反叛者，就滾出去。

scripts.text: ^0000ffYou are already in the test form. If you have finished all your tests, report to Elwin Conick in the Assembly Room^000000.
scripts.translation: ^0000ff你已經處於測試變身狀態。若已完成全部測試，請到組裝室向埃爾溫·科尼克報到^000000。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
Look at yourself, do you really want to test?
scripts.translation:
[埃爾溫·科尼克]
看看你自己，你真的想參加測試嗎？

scripts.text: ^0000ffElwin see you turn into another form and she is very angry. Wait for your current form ends, and then find her again.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff埃爾溫看見你變成別的模樣，很不高興。等變身結束再來找她吧。^000000

scripts.text: Wait.
scripts.translation: 等待

scripts.text: Go away.
scripts.translation: 離開

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
Come back when you aren't in any form.
scripts.translation:
[埃爾溫·科尼克]
等你恢復正常形態後再回來。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
It's not worth to give up, now go out and relax.
scripts.translation:
[埃爾溫·科尼克]
現在放棄不值得，出去放鬆一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
Any leftover Steel Artifacts must be returned after the test.
scripts.translation:
[埃爾溫·科尼克]
測試結束後，剩餘的鐵製加工品必須歸還。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
Any leftover Steel Artifacts must be returned after the test.
scripts.translation:
[埃爾溫·科尼克]
測試結束後，剩餘的鐵製加工品必須歸還。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
Time over. You failed the test. Let me take all your leftover test materials.
scripts.translation:
[埃爾溫·科尼克]
時間到。你測試失敗了。把剩下的測試材料都交給我。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
Listen up. I'm not going to great lengths trying to explain the test to you.
scripts.translation:
[埃爾溫·科尼克]
聽好了，我不會費心把測試內容詳細解釋給你聽。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
This is where the firearm molds are cast. Everywhere you can see Steel Artifacts are being produced.
scripts.translation:
[埃爾溫·科尼克]
這裡是槍械模具鑄造區，到處都在生產鐵製加工品。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
You'll be asked to control switches on the machine and select 5 standard Steel Artifacts.
scripts.translation:
[埃爾溫·科尼克]
你需要操作機器上的開關，並選出5個標準的鐵製加工品。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
We Rebellions are weapon experts at heart. Here you will learn to create and assemble firearms.
scripts.translation:
[埃爾溫·科尼克]
我們反叛者天生就是武器專家。在這裡，你將學習如何製造和組裝槍械。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
You'll be asked to control the furnace controller near the entrance and select 5 standard Steel Artifacts.
scripts.translation:
[埃爾溫·科尼克]
你需要操作入口附近的熔爐控制器，並選出5個標準的鐵製加工品。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
You'll then take them to the next Assembly Room and assemble them info a firearm. You'll be given 3 minutes to do all that. You'd better be fast and focused, or you will fail the test.
scripts.translation:
[埃爾溫·科尼克]
帶著它們去隔壁組裝室，裝出一把槍。
全部步驟只有3分鐘，手要快，注意力要集中，否則就算失敗。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
I'll be in the next room, waiting for you to bring me a complete firearm. To check the elapsed time, you'll be transformed into a different job. ^0000ffIf you pass 3 minutes and turn back to normal, go back to me and start the test again.^000000.
scripts.translation:
[埃爾溫·科尼克]
我在隔壁等你把成品槍帶來。
為了計時，會讓你變成其他職業的模樣。
^0000ff3分鐘後恢復原狀，就回來找我，重新開始測試。^000000

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
You'll then take them to the next Assembly Room and assemble them into a complete firearm. You'll be given 3 minutes to finish all that. ^0000ffTo check the elapsed time, you'll be transformed into a different job^000000.
scripts.translation:
[埃爾溫·科尼克]
把加工品帶到隔壁組裝室，裝出一把完整的槍，限時3分鐘。
^0000ff為了計時，會讓你變成其他職業的模樣^000000。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
I'll be in the next room, waiting for you to bring me a complete firearm. Remember, ^0000ffyou fail the test when your transformation expires after 3 minutes^000000.
scripts.translation:
[埃爾溫·科尼克]
我在隔壁等你帶成品槍過來。
記住，^0000ff3分鐘後變身結束，就算測試失敗^000000。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
Ah? Are you lost? You need to register first and then get back here.
scripts.translation:
[埃爾溫·科尼克]
啊？你迷路了？你需要先註冊，然後再回到這裡。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
If you don't want to join Rebellions, just get out.
scripts.translation:
[埃爾溫·科尼克]
如果你不想加入反叛者，就滾出去。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
Are you done? I don't see any completed firearm in your inventory.
scripts.translation:
[埃爾溫·科尼克]
做完了？你的物品欄裡可沒見到成品槍。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
It's shoddy but not bad, given the time. You passed.
scripts.translation:
[埃爾溫·科尼克]
做工粗糙了點，不過時間這麼緊，也算不錯。
通過。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
Let me take all your leftover test materials.
scripts.translation:
[埃爾溫·科尼克]
把剩下的測試材料都交給我。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
Now you can move on to the next course. Ivan Sidorenko will oversee your test.
scripts.translation:
[埃爾溫·科尼克]
現在你可以進入下一門課程了。伊萬·西多連科將負責監督你的測試。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
Look at yourself, do you really want to test?
scripts.translation:
[埃爾溫·科尼克]
看看你自己，你真的想參加測試嗎？

scripts.text: ^0000ffElwin see you turn into another form and she is very angry. Wait for your current form ends, and then find her again.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff埃爾溫看見你變成別的模樣，很不高興。等變身結束再來找她吧。^000000

scripts.text: Wait.
scripts.translation: 等待

scripts.text: Go away.
scripts.translation: 離開

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
Come back when you aren't in any form.
scripts.translation:
[埃爾溫·科尼克]
等你恢復正常形態後再回來。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
It's not worth to give up, now go out and relax.
scripts.translation:
[埃爾溫·科尼克]
現在放棄不值得，出去放鬆一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
Time over. You failed the test. Let me take all your leftover test materials.
scripts.translation:
[埃爾溫·科尼克]
時間到。你測試失敗了。把剩下的測試材料都交給我。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
Let's start again.
scripts.translation:
[埃爾溫·科尼克]
讓我們重新開始。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
Ah? Are you lost? You need to register first and then get back here.
scripts.translation:
[埃爾溫·科尼克]
啊？你迷路了？你需要先註冊，然後再回到這裡。

scripts.text: Only authorized user can do the operation.
scripts.translation: 只有獲授權的使用者才能執行此操作。

scripts.text: Do you want to dredge the mold up from the furnace?
scripts.translation: 要從熔爐中取出模具嗎？

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text: Begin.
scripts.translation: 開始

scripts.text: Switch to the Standby mode.
scripts.translation: 切換至待機模式

scripts.text: Initializing Furnace Controller ZX-3100...
scripts.translation: 正在初始化熔爐控制器 ZX-3100...

scripts.text: Not an authorized user. Abort the operation.
scripts.translation: 非授權使用者。中止操作。

scripts.text: Only authorized user can do the operation.
scripts.translation: 只有獲授權的使用者才能執行此操作。

scripts.text: Unauthorized firearm creation has been detected. Report to Manager Elwin.
scripts.translation: 檢測到未授權的槍械製造行為。請向管理員埃爾溫報告。

scripts.text: You do not have standard Steel Artifacts.
scripts.translation: 您沒有標準的鐵製加工品。

scripts.text: Do you want to use the auto anvil and shape the standard Steel Artifacts into a firearm?
scripts.translation: 您要用自動鐵砧將標準的鐵製加工品塑造成槍械嗎？

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text: Begin.
scripts.translation: 開始

scripts.text: For your safety, please step away from the auto anvil.
scripts.translation: 為了您的安全，請遠離自動鐵砧。

scripts.text: You have successfully created a firearm using the auto anvil. ^ff0000Please report before your transformation expires^000000.
scripts.translation:
已使用自動鐵砧成功製造出槍械。
^ff0000請在變身結束前報到^000000。

scripts.text: Failed to create a firearm.
scripts.translation: 槍械製造失敗。

scripts.text: Not an authorized user. Abort the operation.
scripts.translation: 非授權使用者。中止操作。

scripts.text: The system is busy dredging a completed mold from the furnace.
scripts.translation: 系統正忙於從熔爐中取出已完成的模具。

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
This is shooting test area, you can't come here as you like.
scripts.translation:
[伊萬·西多連科]
這裡是射擊測試區，你不能隨意進入。

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
There seems to be a mistake, you can't stay here.
scripts.translation:
[伊萬·西多連科]
似乎出了點差錯，你不能留在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
Hey, stay focused--we're using live ammo here, and you can get shot anytime.
scripts.translation:
[伊萬·西多連科]
喂，集中精神！這裡用的可都是真子彈，隨時有可能挨槍子。

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
Let me make this quick. Basically you'll be running in this shooting range consisting of 5 sections.
scripts.translation:
[伊萬·西多連科]
簡單說，這個射擊場分成5個區域，你得一路跑過去。

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
The objective is to find enemies in the midst of a crowd quickly and without fail.
scripts.translation:
[伊萬·西多連科]
目標是在人群中快速且準確地找到敵人。

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
Among all the targets, you must shoot only the ^0000ffStandard-issue Targets^000000. If you make a mistake, you'll lose points.
scripts.translation:
[伊萬·西多連科]
所有靶子裡，只能射擊^0000ff標準目標^000000，打錯要扣分。

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
Let's try. There aren't many ^0000ffStandard-issue Targets^000000, so keep your eyes peeled.
scripts.translation:
[伊萬·西多連科]
讓我們試試。^0000ff標準目標^000000並不多，所以請睜大眼睛。

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
^0000ffYou have 3 minutes to finish this test. If you can't finish before your transformation expires^000000, you'll fail. If that happens, just follow the path back to me.
scripts.translation:
[伊萬·西多連科]
^0000ff測試限時3分鐘，必須在變身結束前完成^000000，否則就算失敗。
失敗了就沿路回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
^0000ffYou'll fail if you miss a Standard-issue Target, or shoot 3 incorrect targets^000000. Let's get started.
scripts.translation:
[伊萬·西多連科]
^0000ff漏打標準目標，或打錯3個目標，都會失敗^000000。
開始吧。

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
Good job. I didn't think you could pass so quickly.
scripts.translation:
[伊萬·西多連科]
幹得好。我沒想到你能這麼快通過。

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
You may leave and wait outside. I'll bring other instructors' evaluation reports to see you.
scripts.translation:
[伊萬·西多連科]
你可以離開，在外面等著。我會帶著其他教官的評估報告來找你。

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
You're quick enough, but you shot too many incorrect targets. You failed.
scripts.translation:
[伊萬·西多連科]
夠快，可惜打錯太多，失敗。

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
You accurate enough, but you took too much time. Slow Rebellions don't survive long enough.
scripts.translation:
[伊萬·西多連科]
夠準，可是太慢。
動作遲緩的反叛者可活不長。

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
You failed at both speed and accuracy. How did you survive this long?
scripts.translation:
[伊萬·西多連科]
速度不行，準頭也不行，你怎麼活到現在的？

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
There's a problem, the statistic seems to be wrong. Well... This can happen sometimes.
scripts.translation:
[伊萬·西多連科]
出了點問題，統計資料似乎有誤。嗯...這種情況偶爾會發生。

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
Let's try again. Be more careful this time.
scripts.translation:
[伊萬·西多連科]
讓我們再試一次。這次請更小心些。

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
How did you not leave?
scripts.translation:
[伊萬·西多連科]
你怎麼還沒離開？

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
You may leave and wait outside. I'll bring other instructors' evaluation reports to see you.
scripts.translation:
[伊萬·西多連科]
你可以離開，在外面等著。我會帶著其他教官的評估報告來找你。

scripts.text: You have too many items, please reduce them to continue.
scripts.translation: 你的物品欄太滿了，請整理物品以繼續。

scripts.text: The items in your inventory are weighing you down. Lighten your weight first.
scripts.translation: 你背包裡的物品太重了，影響了行動。請先減輕負重。

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
There must have been a mistake. You aren't supposed to remain here.
scripts.translation:
[伊萬·西多連科]
一定是搞錯了。你不應該還留在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
Huh? You look so weak? I have nothing more to say.
scripts.translation:
[伊萬·西多連科]
咦？你看起來好虛弱啊。我無話可說了。

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
Oh no~ You still have Skill Points.
scripts.translation:
[伊萬·西多連科]
哎呀~你還有技能點沒用完呢。

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
Kulbertinov, Elwin, and I've evaluated your Rebellion test results.
scripts.translation:
[伊萬·西多連科]
庫爾貝爾蒂諾夫、埃爾溫和我已經評估了你的反叛者測試結果。

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
And...
scripts.translation:
[伊萬·西多連科]
還有...

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
You've met all our requirements including the attitude and the test performance.
scripts.translation:
[伊萬·西多連科]
不論態度還是測試表現，你都達到了我們的要求。

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
That's right, you're now a member of the Rebellion. Get ready to be wowed.
scripts.translation:
[伊萬·西多連科]
沒錯，從現在起，你就是反叛者的一員。
準備好大開眼界吧。

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
And Elwin wants you to have this. Take good care of it. He made it for you.
scripts.translation:
[伊萬·西多連科]
還有，埃爾溫想把這個送給你。請好好保管。這是專門為你做的。

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
See you later.
scripts.translation:
[伊萬·西多連科]
回見。

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
This life should be fun, not boring.
scripts.translation:
[伊萬·西多連科]
人生應該充滿樂趣，而不是枯燥乏味。

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
And by becoming a Rebellion your life should be upgraded. So, go and create a great journey, make us proud!
scripts.translation:
[伊萬·西多連科]
成為反叛者，你的人生也該更上一層樓了。
去闖出一番天地，讓我們為你驕傲吧！

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
Do you have something to say to me, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[伊萬·西多連科]
你還有什麼想對我說的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Butler Karlex]
Use this temporary storage to keep your items safe while on the Advancement test.
scripts.translation:
[管家卡萊克斯]
轉職測試期間，可使用這個臨時倉庫保管物品。

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text: Open the storage.
scripts.translation: 開啟倉庫

scripts.text:
[Butler Karlex]
Thank you for using the service.
scripts.translation:
[管家卡萊克斯]
感謝您使用服務。

scripts.text:
[Time Manager]
What time would you like to return?
scripts.translation:
[時間管理員]
你想在什麼時間返回？

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: Test monster spawn
scripts.translation: 測試魔物生成

scripts.text: Start from beginning
scripts.translation: 從頭開始

scripts.text: Furnace Zone
scripts.translation: 熔爐區域

scripts.text: Shooting Zone
scripts.translation: 射擊區域

scripts.text: Complete the test
scripts.translation: 完成測試
